title: Selah | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the home features an airy open-concept layout centered around a chef’s kitchen fitted with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, an oversized island, and generous seating for gathering. Each bedroom includes its own en-suite bath, while the upper levels offer a series of cozy, light-filled lounge spaces—including a charming tower retreat with sweeping views of Seaside and the Gulf. The separate carriage house delivers added privacy with its own living and kitchen spaces, perfect for multi-family stays or guests wanting their own slice of serenity. Whether basking poolside or enjoying a sunrise from the tower balcony, Selah invites you to unwind in effortless coastal elegance. Just steps from the sugar-white sands of Seaside, Selah captures the essence of refined coastal living from its prized location. With its enviable proximity—only one home away from 30A and moments from the Ruskin pavilion beach access—this four-bedroom retreat (plus private carriage house) offers a perfect blend of luxury, space, and intimacy for up to ten guests. A viewing tower with breathtaking Gulf views, a rare covered swimming pool, and thoughtful design touches throughout make Selah a standout sanctuary for those seeking a classic yet elevated Southern beach escape.
